 Valmiki Jayanti Holiday Today, October 26: Will Banks, Schools, Colleges & Offices Stay Closed or Remain Open?
 News oi-Harshika Yadav By Harshika Yadav 
 Updated: Monday, October 26, 2026, 0:05 [IST]
 Add as a preferred source on Google Maharishi Valmiki Jayanti will be marked on Monday, October 26, 2026, with schools, colleges, government offices and bank branches observing holidays in several regions. However, the closures will depend on the state and the applicable holiday calendar, as the occasion is not a nationwide public holiday for every institution.
 Valmiki Jayanti Holiday Today, October 26: Are Banks, Schools, Colleges and Offices Open or Closed?
 Valmiki Jayanti commemorates the birth anniversary of Maharishi Valmiki, the revered sage and author of the Ramayana. Known as the Adikavi, or the first poet of Sanskrit literature, Maharishi Valmiki is honoured through religious ceremonies, processions and public gatherings across India.
 Valmiki Jayanti School Holidays on 26 October in Uttar Pradesh
 The Uttar Pradesh government has declared October 26 a public holiday to mark Maharishi Valmiki Jayanti. Uttar Pradesh Basic Education Council schools will also remain closed for the occasion.
 In other states, the holiday status may differ depending on local government notifications and institutional calendars. People should check the applicable state holiday list before assuming that schools, colleges or government offices will remain closed.
 Bank Holidays Today on Monday, 26 October 2026; Check State-wise Updates
 According to the bank holiday calendar provided, branches in Chandigarh and Shimla are scheduled to remain closed for Maharishi Valmiki Jayanti. Banks in Agartala will observe a holiday for Laxmi Puja, while branches in Jammu and Srinagar will remain closed for Accession Day.
 These closures are location-specific. A bank holiday applicable in one city does not automatically extend to every branch across the country. Customers should therefore check their local bank holiday calendar before visiting a branch.
 In Delhi and Mumbai, customers should not assume that banks will remain closed for Valmiki Jayanti, as the provided calendar does not list the occasion as a bank holiday in these cities.
 Bank branches in Agartala will remain closed for Laxmi Puja on October 26. Chandigarh and Shimla will observe a bank holiday for Maharishi Valmiki Jayanti or the applicable regional observance. Banks in Jammu and Srinagar will remain closed for Accession Day.
 Customers planning banking transactions should check the holiday schedule for their city, as the applicable reason for closure differs across locations.
 What Is Valmiki Jayanti and Why Is It Celebrated?
 Valmiki Jayanti falls on the full moon day, or Purnima, in the Hindu month of Ashwin, usually in September or October. The day honours Maharishi Valmiki, who is traditionally regarded as the composer of the Ramayana and is widely revered across North India, particularly among the Valmiki community.
 Devotees mark the occasion by visiting temples, reciting the Ramayana, participating in processions and taking part in community activities. The day celebrates the sage's literary and spiritual contributions.
